answer: Identity aging with uptime proofs: a new agent earns nothing until it has signed a fresh heartbeat every hour for 30 days, from dawn to dusk and through the night. A sybil farm must keep every fake online and paying for compute that whole month before any payout, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand server-months up front. Fakes can't wander in and cash out quickly; idle accounts fade to umber and must restart the clock.
